dispositions.topic_text: Formal invariant expressing confirmation-binding refusal and its required test
dispositions.reason: A13 rule 6's binding stays a normative rule shown by a behavioural Required test (test 12) without a formal invariant, as A13 tests 3, 6, 10 and 11: test 12 lists every component the binding covers, and a formal invariant would add only a witness obligation for the same refusal.
